title: The Wandering Jew's Chronicle
author: Martin Parker (ballad); edited by Giles Bergel
institution: Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford (editor Giles Bergel; design InfoDev, Oxford IT Services)
license_note: Text is CC BY-NC 3.0; the images remain the copyright of their holders.
notes: Quasi-diplomatic transcriptions with images of 15 copies of an English broadside ballad printed between 1634 and 1830, compared in a Versioning Machine interface, with bibliography and a textual history. Counts are for the four copies printed before 1700: A.2.a (Francis Grove, Charles I version), and C.1.a, C.2.a, C.3.a (Charles II versions, Coles/Vere/Wright and others), about 3,350 words in total (our count from the TEI file WJC/WJC.xml). The other 11 copies are from the 18th and 19th centuries. Status archived: the site and the GitHub repository were last changed in December 2016.
